#Text=The image is a detailed map of the Cantabria region in northern Spain, highlighting the road network and major towns and cities.
#Text=Here’s a breakdown of the map’s content:  Geographical Features:   The map shows the coastal and inland areas of Cantabria.
#Text=The Bay of Biscay is visible to the north, indicating the region’s coastal location.
#Text=Major Cities and Towns:   Santander: The capital city of Cantabria, located on the northern coast.
#Text=Torrelavega: Situated south of Santander, it is a significant urban center.
#Text=Castro Urdiales: Located on the eastern coast.
#Text=Laredo and Santoña: Coastal towns east of Santander.
#Text=Reinosa and Potes: Inland towns in the southern part of the region.
#Text=Road Network:   The map displays various roads, including highways and local routes.

#Text=Topography:   The map shows mountainous areas, particularly in the southern part of Cantabria.
#Text=The Picos de Europa, a notable mountain range, is indicated in the southwest.
